fields.label: Total fluid estimated intake in 24 hours

example_question.en: About how much fluid do you drink in a typical day?
example_question.ms: Berapa banyak cecair (air, kopi, teh, dll) yang anda minum dalam sehari?

fields.example_answer: I drink about 6 glasses of water plus 2 cups of coffee
fields.clinical_relevance: Heart failure patients have fluid restriction; over-intake worsens edema and dyspnea

fields.label: Alcohol intake in one week

example_question.en: How much alcohol do you drink in a typical week?
example_question.ms: Berapa banyak alkohol yang anda minum dalam seminggu?

fields.example_answer: Maybe 2-3 beers on weekends
fields.clinical_relevance: Alcohol elevates BP and triglycerides; affects warfarin and antiarrhythmics

fields.label: Tobacco use

example_question.en: Do you currently smoke or use any tobacco?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda merokok atau menggunakan tembakau?

fields.example_answer: I quit 5 years ago
fields.clinical_relevance: Major modifiable risk factor for ischemic heart disease

fields.label: Total fat intake (qualitative estimate from food sources)

example_question.en: How often do you eat fried foods, fatty meats, or oily curries?
example_question.ms: Berapa kerap anda makan makanan goreng, daging berlemak, atau kari berminyak?

fields.example_answer: Most days I have nasi lemak or fried chicken
fields.clinical_relevance: Total fat affects LDL and overall cardiovascular risk
fields.extractor_note: Estimate qualitative level (low/moderate/high) from food sources mentioned. Don't ask patients for grams.

fields.label: Sodium intake / awareness

example_question.en: How salty do you like your food, and do you ever check labels for sodium?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda suka makanan masin, dan adakah anda memeriksa kandungan garam pada label?

fields.example_answer: I add salt to almost everything, never check labels
fields.clinical_relevance: Direct driver of hypertension and fluid retention in heart failure
fields.tier_change_note: Promoted from T2 → T1 for cardiac focus

fields.label: Food allergies and intolerances

example_question.en: Do you have any food allergies or foods that make you feel unwell?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda alah kepada makanan atau ada makanan yang membuat anda tidak sihat?

fields.example_answer: I'm allergic to shellfish and dairy gives me stomach issues
fields.clinical_relevance: Required to ensure dietary recommendations are safe

fields.label: Religion (affects diet)

example_question.en: Are there foods you avoid for religious or cultural reasons?
example_question.ms: Adakah ada makanan yang anda elak atas sebab agama atau budaya?

fields.example_answer: I'm Muslim so I only eat halal, no pork
fields.clinical_relevance: Required to ensure dietary recommendations are culturally acceptable

fields.label: Medication compliance

example_question.en: Are you taking your medications as prescribed?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda mengambil ubat seperti yang ditetapkan oleh doktor?

fields.example_answer: Sometimes I forget the evening dose
fields.clinical_relevance: Non-compliance with antihypertensives, statins, or anticoagulants directly worsens outcomes

fields.label: Fat type sources (raw food sources mentioned)

example_question.en: What kinds of cooking oils, butter, or fatty foods do you usually have?
example_question.ms: Jenis minyak masak atau makanan berlemak apa yang biasa anda makan?

fields.example_answer: I cook with palm oil and use butter on toast
fields.clinical_relevance: Saturated/trans fat sources matter more than total fat for cardiac patients
fields.extractor_note: Capture raw food sources (palm oil, butter, ghee, olive oil, etc.); separate clinical layer maps to saturated/trans/unsaturated categories

fields.label: Physical activity frequency

example_question.en: How often do you exercise or do physical activity?
example_question.ms: Berapa kerap anda bersenam atau melakukan aktiviti fizikal?

fields.example_answer: I walk for 30 minutes 3 times a week
fields.clinical_relevance: Frequency drives cardiac rehabilitation outcomes

fields.label: Physical activity duration

example_question.en: About how long do your exercise sessions last?
example_question.ms: Lama setiap sesi senaman anda berapa minit?

fields.example_answer: 30 to 45 minutes each time
fields.clinical_relevance: Total weekly minutes determine training effect

fields.label: Type of physical activity

example_question.en: What kind of exercise do you do — walking, swimming, gym, sports?
example_question.ms: Jenis senaman apa yang anda lakukan — berjalan, berenang, gim, atau sukan?

fields.example_answer: Mostly walking, sometimes I cycle on weekends
fields.clinical_relevance: Aerobic vs resistance vs flexibility have different cardiac benefits

fields.label: Physical activity intensity

example_question.en: Would you describe your exercise as light, moderate, or vigorous?
example_question.ms: Senaman anda boleh dikatakan ringan, sederhana, atau cergas?

fields.example_answer: Moderate - I get a bit out of breath
fields.clinical_relevance: Vigorous activity may be contraindicated in some cardiac conditions

fields.label: Total caffeine estimated intake in 24 hours

example_question.en: How much coffee or tea do you drink a day?
example_question.ms: Berapa banyak kopi atau teh yang anda minum sehari?

fields.example_answer: Two cups of coffee in the morning
fields.clinical_relevance: Excess caffeine can trigger arrhythmias and elevate BP

fields.label: Number of meals estimated in 24 hours

example_question.en: How many meals do you eat in a day?
example_question.ms: Berapa kali anda makan dalam sehari?

fields.example_answer: Three main meals plus 2 snacks usually
fields.clinical_relevance: Meal pattern affects glycemic control and energy distribution

fields.label: Number of snacks estimated in 24 hours

example_question.en: How many snacks do you have between meals?
example_question.ms: Berapa kali anda makan snek antara waktu makan?

fields.example_answer: 1 or 2 snacks usually
fields.clinical_relevance: Frequent snacking may reflect calorie excess

fields.label: Processed food intake

example_question.en: How often do you eat processed or packaged foods?
example_question.ms: Berapa kerap anda makan makanan diproses atau makanan dalam tin/bungkus?

fields.example_answer: Maybe once a week, mostly home-cooked
fields.clinical_relevance: Processed foods are major source of sodium and trans fats

fields.label: Quick service food intake

example_question.en: How often do you eat fast food or takeaway?
example_question.ms: Berapa kerap anda makan makanan segera atau bawa pulang?

fields.example_answer: Twice a week or so
fields.clinical_relevance: Fast food typically high in saturated fat, sodium, and refined carbs

fields.label: Self prepared food intake

example_question.en: Do you usually cook your own meals or does someone else?
example_question.ms: Biasanya anda yang masak sendiri atau orang lain yang masak?

fields.example_answer: My wife cooks most days
fields.clinical_relevance: Determines who needs nutrition education and meal control

fields.label: Sugar sweetened beverage estimated oral intake in 24 hours

example_question.en: Do you drink sweetened drinks like soda, juice, or sweetened tea?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda minum minuman manis seperti air kotak, jus, atau teh manis?

fields.example_answer: I have one teh tarik a day
fields.clinical_relevance: Liquid sugar contributes to obesity, insulin resistance, hypertriglyceridemia

fields.label: Food avoidance

example_question.en: Are there any foods you avoid eating, and why?
example_question.ms: Adakah ada makanan yang anda elak makan, dan kenapa?

fields.example_answer: I avoid fatty foods because they upset my stomach
fields.clinical_relevance: Voluntary restrictions inform what dietary advice will be acceptable

fields.label: Cultural/religious eating practices

example_question.en: Are there cultural or family traditions that shape what you eat?
example_question.ms: Adakah amalan budaya atau tradisi keluarga yang mempengaruhi pemakanan anda?

fields.example_answer: We always have rice with every meal
fields.clinical_relevance: Cultural norms shape food choices; advice must be culturally adapted

fields.label: Nutrition knowledge of individual client

example_question.en: How familiar are you with what foods to eat for your condition?
example_question.ms: Sejauh mana anda tahu makanan yang sesuai untuk keadaan kesihatan anda?

fields.example_answer: I know I should eat less salt but not much else
fields.clinical_relevance: Determines depth of education needed

fields.label: Readiness to change nutrition-related behaviors

example_question.en: How ready do you feel to make changes to your diet?
example_question.ms: Sejauh mana anda bersedia untuk mengubah pemakanan anda?

fields.example_answer: I'm trying to eat less rice already
fields.clinical_relevance: Stage of change determines intervention approach

fields.label: Vitamin/mineral supplement intake

example_question.en: Are you taking any vitamins, minerals, or other supplements?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda mengambil sebarang vitamin, mineral, atau suplemen?

fields.example_answer: I take fish oil and CoQ10 daily
fields.clinical_relevance: Common cardiac supplements (fish oil, CoQ10, K, Mg) interact with medications
fields.tier_change_note: Demoted from T1 → T3 for cardiac focus per dietitian

fields.label: Food availability

example_question.en: Is it easy for you to buy fresh fruit, vegetables, and lean proteins?
example_question.ms: Adakah mudah untuk anda membeli buah-buahan, sayur-sayuran, dan protein yang sihat?

fields.example_answer: Yes, there's a market nearby
fields.clinical_relevance: Affects feasibility of dietary recommendations

fields.label: Alcohol intake pattern on drinking days

example_question.en: On days you drink, do you usually have one drink or several?
example_question.ms: Pada hari anda minum, biasanya satu gelas atau beberapa gelas?

fields.example_answer: Usually 2-3 in one sitting
fields.clinical_relevance: Binge pattern more harmful than equivalent spread intake

fields.label: Access to food preparation equipment

example_question.en: Do you have a kitchen with a stove and refrigerator?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda mempunyai dapur dengan dapur masak dan peti sejuk?

fields.example_answer: Yes, just basic but it works
fields.clinical_relevance: Affects whether home-cooking advice is realistic

fields.label: Eating environment (alone/with family/etc)

example_question.en: Do you usually eat alone or with others?
example_question.ms: Biasanya anda makan seorang diri atau bersama orang lain?

fields.example_answer: With my family for dinner, lunch is at work
fields.clinical_relevance: Social context affects portion control and food choices

fields.label: Daily stress level

example_question.en: How stressful would you say your daily life is, on a scale of 1 to 10?
example_question.ms: Pada skala 1 hingga 10, sejauh mana stres dalam kehidupan harian anda?

fields.example_answer: About a 7, work has been intense
fields.clinical_relevance: Stress drives BP elevation and unhealthy coping behaviors

fields.label: Occupation

example_question.en: What do you do for work?
example_question.ms: Apakah pekerjaan anda?

fields.example_answer: I'm a teacher, mostly desk work
fields.clinical_relevance: Occupation influences activity level and meal patterns

fields.label: Social and medical support

example_question.en: Do you have family or friends helping you manage your health?
example_question.ms: Adakah keluarga atau kawan yang membantu anda menjaga kesihatan?

fields.example_answer: My daughter helps with my appointments
fields.clinical_relevance: Support network predicts adherence and outcomes

fields.label: Fiber estimated intake

example_question.en: Do you eat whole grains, beans, or lots of fruits and vegetables?
example_question.ms: Adakah anda makan bijirin penuh, kekacang, atau banyak buah dan sayur?

fields.example_answer: Some fruit daily, mostly white rice for grains
fields.clinical_relevance: Fiber lowers LDL cholesterol; relevant for cardiac too

fields.label: Nutrition quality of life

example_question.en: How happy are you with the way you eat right now?
example_question.ms: Sejauh mana anda berpuas hati dengan pemakanan anda sekarang?

fields.example_answer: Not really, I want to change but it's hard
fields.clinical_relevance: Predicts long-term adherence and satisfaction
